primitives.name: Expected Points Added
primitives.assumptions: Markovian state transition; linear utility over expected points; no carryover effects beyond immediate outcome.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Zero-sum, single-outcome games where total points remain constant across all possible futures.

layer2.mapping: Dual to "Win Probability Added" under time-reversal duality; maps to GSI via "Expected Value" as the posterior mean of win probability.
layer2.telemetry: Residual variance after regressing actual point differential on EPA sum, measuring predictive uncertainty.

primitives.name: Win Probability Added
primitives.assumptions: Markov chain model of game state; binary win/loss outcome; no draw probability.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Non-linear utility in win probability; singular at 0% and 100% win probability thresholds.

layer2.mapping: Time-reversed dual of EPA; maps to GSI via "Closing Line Value" as the signed log-odds of optimal betting strategy.
layer2.telemetry: Correlation with final margin after controlling for WPA sum, detecting systematic information leakage.

primitives.name: Separation
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Separation** (NGS) - Priority: HIGH - Category: Next Gen Stats 8.
primitives.assumptions: Continuous tracking data available; defined only on completed passes; Euclidean distance metric.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Discontinuity at zero separation indicating defensive interference; unbounded separation in theory but capped in practice.

layer2.mapping: Kernel density estimation of receiving success conditioned on separation; maps to GSE via "Catch Probability" as a state-transition feature.
layer2.telemetry: Standard deviation of separation distribution within a drive, measuring offensive play design consistency.
